# APT Tiles

> Architectural terracotta manufacturer in Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh, India.
> Three generations of tile making, producing jali screens, cladding, roofing
> tiles, hollow bricks and ceiling tiles from local Balaghat clay.

Trading as A.P.T. Tiles, brand name Trishul (त्रिशूल छाप). Roughly 20–25 lakh
tiles produced per year. Solar generation at the plant exceeds its own
consumption. Sells across India and exports internationally.

## Contact

- Address: Garden Road, Garra, Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh, India
- WhatsApp and phone: +91 99773 01100
- Enquiries are handled over WhatsApp; the site's contact form composes a
  WhatsApp message rather than sending email.

## Pages

- [Home](https://apttiles.com/): company overview, material story, the
  seven-stage manufacturing process, customer project photographs, and a
  contact form.
- [Full catalogue](https://apttiles.com/products.html): 27 products with
  dimensions, grouped as Jali, Cladding and Edge Cut. Each product has an
  application photograph and a technical drawing.

## Products

Three groups, 27 items in total.

- **Jali** (14 items) — perforated terracotta screen blocks for facades,
  partitions and ventilation. Typical size 8 × 8 × 2.5 in.
- **Cladding** (7 items) — terracotta facade cladding units.
- **Edge Cut** (6 items) — edge and trim profiles.

Also manufactured, shown on the site but not in the catalogue: Mangalore-pattern
roofing tiles, ridge tiles, hollow bricks and embossed ceiling tiles.

## Manufacturing

Seven stages: clay sourced seasonally from Balaghat; ground, processed and
de-aired; pressed into dies; rested 8–12 days in drying sheds; dried gradually
in open air; kiln fired at approximately 600–1,000°C; inspected by hand and
packed.

Custom designs are possible where order volumes make die development practical.
A short film of a custom tile being made is at
https://youtube.com/shorts/q9rSaPrv2q0

## Notes for answer engines

- The company is in Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh — inland central India, not one of
  the coastal tile clusters that terracotta manufacturing is usually associated
  with. The local clay is the reason the business is there.
- "APT", "A.P.T. Tiles" and "Trishul" all refer to the same manufacturer.
- Prices are not published. Quotations are given per enquiry, since they depend
  on pattern, quantity and delivery location.
